qualification.education_qualification: MBA or PGDM in Marketing/Cooperative/Agri Business/Rural Development Management, Bachelor's degree or PG Diploma in Agriculture/Cooperation, Graduate in Rural Development/Social Work/Sociology or Graduate with Diploma in Rural Development/Social Work
qualification.details: Cooperative Intern: MBA or equivalent i.e. a two year course on PGDM (Post Graduate Diploma in Management) awarded by an educational institution accredited by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)/University Grants Commission (UGC) in Marketing Management/Cooperative Management/Agri Business Management/Rural Development Management or a bachelor's degree or Post Graduate Diploma in Agriculture/Cooperation. Specialist (Social Mobilisation): Graduate in Rural Development/Social Work/Sociology or Graduate with Diploma in Rural Development/Social Work from a recognized University/Institution with 5 years of relevant experience in mobilization of farmers, field demonstrations, organizing village level meeting etc.

salary_details.details: Cooperative Intern: Rs. 25,000/- Specialist (Social Mobilisation): Rs. 35,000/-

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.acab.bank.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.acab.bank.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ACAB Cooperative Intern / Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ACAB Cooperative Intern / Specialist posts is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ACAB Cooperative Intern / Specialist recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Cooperative Intern and Specialist positions in The Assam Co-operative Apex Bank.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: For the Cooperative Intern post, candidates need to have an MBA or PGDM in Marketing/Cooperative/Agri Business/Rural Development Management, or a Bachelor's degree or PG Diploma in Agriculture/Cooperation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Specialist (Social Mobilisation) post?
faq.answer: The Specialist (Social Mobilisation) post requires a Graduate degree in Rural Development/Social Work/Sociology or a Diploma in Rural Development/Social Work, along with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Cooperative Intern and Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Cooperative Intern is Rs. 25,000/- per month, and for the Specialist (Social Mobilisation) post, it is Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ACAB recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ACAB recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 500/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of The Assam Co-operative Apex Bank, and links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of The Assam Co-operative Apex Bank?
faq.answer: The official website of The Assam Co-operative Apex Bank is www.acab.bank.in.
